message: You know that one friend who panics at the first hint of a storm? That’s my neighbor, Judy. Last winter, when the forecast hinted at a little snow, she was already digging out her snow shovel and hoarding bread like it was the last loaf on earth. I just chuckled and made sure to have a couple of cozy blankets and hot cocoa on hand. Sometimes, a calm cup of cocoa is all the prep you need to ride out a storm. What’s your go-to comfort during a weather scare? ☕
